name: keepmark-app
description: Keepmark browser extension (Firefox first, then Chromium MV3). xBrowserSync-compatible bookmark sync.
author: Keepmark (https://github.com/Keepmark)

scripts.build: npm run build:firefox && npm run build:chromium
scripts.build:firefox: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.chromium.json && vite build --config vite.firefox.ts
scripts.build:chromium: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.chromium.json && rm -rf build/chromium && vite build --config vite.chromium.ts && vite build --config vite.chromium-sw.ts
